0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>Vondia has tea to brew, but no ingredients to do so.

24.original: Use the preserving agent on tea mushrooms.

26.original: Deliver the treated tea mushrooms to Vondia.

48.original: Excuse me, <hex:02080EE905FF056D697373FF0473697203>. You are one of the visitors from the Crystarium, yes? I realize this is sudden, but may I ask you to gather something for me when next you venture into the woods?

49.original: I am to hold a tea ceremony <hex:020855E3E90C0DFF28020824E3E90C05FF0E6F6E20746865206D6F72726F77FF0F746869732061667465726E6F6F6E03FF26020822E3E90C12FF0D74686973206576656E696E67FF0E6F6E20746865206D6F72726F770303>, but only now remembered I have depleted my store of tea mushrooms.

50.original: I have not much, but I will see you duly compensated for your troubles.

51.original: They can be found to the south in the Citia Swamps. But before you go, you will need this─a preserving agent for the mushrooms. They are quite delicate, and prone to releasing their spores prematurely without it.

52.original: If you could gather five, that will be more than enough.

53.original: Remember to use the preserving agent before you pick them.

54.original: I pray you had no trouble finding the mushrooms?

56.original: They contain an ever-so-slight amount of poison, you know. Not enough to cause adverse effects, mind you, but over time one can build an immunity to similar toxins.

57.original: Would you care for a cup? It's the least I can do. ...No?

58.original: Well, if you should change your mind, I would be more than willing to prepare some for you.
